notes.title: 🧟 Weekly Update - Sep 11, 2025 – Shadows, Snipers & Smarter Arenas
notes.content:
[p][/p][previewyoutube="k3qiKj0s6Xs;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Hello Survivors,

This week we’ve focused on polishing the gameplay feel and tightening combat dynamics. Here’s what’s new:

[/p][list][*][p][b]🌑 Visual Depth Upgrade[/b]

* Added circular shadows beneath both enemies and players for a stronger sense of depth and immersion.
* Shadows now use a reusable component for consistent visuals across all entities.

[/p][/*][*][p][b]🎯 Sniper Rifle Fixes[/b]

* Sniper bullets now properly ricochet and only target enemies (no more weird interactions).
* Adjusted weapon classification for better consistency across sniper rifles.

[/p][/*][*][p][b]⚔️ Arena Improvements[/b]

* Refined arena limiter mechanics: increased activation chance and smoothed radius handling for fairer, more intense wave battles.

[/p][/*][*][p][b]📢 Community Hub[/b]

* Added a Discord server icon directly on the home screen—join us, share feedback, and survive together!
  [/p][/*][/list][p]
That’s all for now—jump in, test the new feel, and let us know what you think. Stay sharp, stay alive.

— The [i]Zombie Survivor[/i] Team
[/p]

notes.title: 🧟 Weekly Update - Aug 18, 2025 – Smarter Waves, Sharper Fights! 🧟‍♂️
notes.content:
Hi Survivors,

This week’s update brings some exciting changes to keep the battlefield even more intense and dynamic:

[h3]🧨 New Wave-Based Deployment[/h3]

[list]
[*] In addition to the continuous zombie flow, enemies can now arrive in group-based waves.
[*] This lays the foundation for upcoming subroutines and opens the door to richer, more varied encounters.
[/list]

[h3]💥 Boss Fight Encounters[/h3]

[list]
[*] Wave deployments now come with a small chance of triggering a boss fight.
[*] During these battles, your movement area will be restricted until you clear out all zombies—escape is not an option, only survival.
[/list]

[h3]✨ Visual Feedback Upgrade[/h3]

[list]
[*] Zombies now flash white when hit, giving clearer impact feedback and making every shot feel more satisfying.
[/list]

That’s all for this week’s drop—thanks for playing, and keep your weapons loaded. The horde is always watching…

— The Zombie Survivor Team

notes.title: Weekly Update – August 11, 2025 - I18N
notes.content:
[p][/p][previewyoutube="3Bw7avIepBM;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Hey everyone!
This week’s patch focuses on making the game more accessible to players worldwide and helping new adventurers find their footing. We’ve also tackled a pesky animation glitch that some of you reported—thank you for the feedback!

[/p][h2]🌍 New Language Support[/h2][p]We’ve expanded localization so more players can enjoy the game in their native language. The following languages are now fully supported:


 Simplified Chinese
 German
 Japanese

All menus, UI elements and gameplay instructions are translated for a smoother experience.

[/p][h2]📖 Player Guide Added[/h2][p]New to the game? We’ve got you covered! A built-in guide is now available from the main menu, complete with tips, explanations, and settings to customize how you view the guide.

[/p][h2]🕹 Animation Fixes[/h2][p]
Fixed an issue where player animations could appear “torn” or out of sync in certain actions. Animations should now appear smooth and consistent.

That’s it for this week! We’re continuing to refine gameplay, expand features, and make the world feel even more alive. As always, your feedback helps shape the future of the game—see you next update!

— The Dev Team[/p]

notes.title: Weekly Update - Aug 4, 2025 - Roll/Dodge
notes.content:
[p][/p][previewyoutube="sQm6Z5JZCBQ;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Hey everyone![/p][p]We’ve been busy polishing core systems and making gameplay feel smoother and more intuitive. Here’s what’s new in this week’s update:[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]⚔️ New Endurance & Rolling Mechanic[/b][/p][list][*][p]We’ve introduced a [b]roll/dodge ability[/b], fully integrated with a brand-new [b]endurance system[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Your endurance now affects how often you can roll, adding a layer of strategy to movement.[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]UI has been updated[/b] to clearly display endurance levels in real-time.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]🎯 Adaptive Weapon Selection[/b][/p][list][*][p]Now supports both [b]radial and linear layouts[/b] for smoother input handling—whether you're using mouse, keyboard, or controller.[/p][/*][*][p]Behind the scenes, we’ve improved [b]weapon range validation and target filtering[/b] for more accurate combat behavior.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]🧰 UI & Settings Polish[/b][/p][list][*][p]Major [b]refactor of UI elements[/b], including the removal of unused labels and cleaner integration of player indicators like endurance.[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]settings system[/b] has been rebuilt with better organization and support for multiple configuration providers.[/p][/*][*][p]Default mode is now [b]fullscreen[/b], with improved aspect ratio handling and window stretching.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]Thanks for all the feedback and bug reports—it really helps guide development!
More gameplay improvements and performance fixes are coming soon. Stay tuned![/p][p]—[i] Dev Team[/i][/p]

notes.title: Weekly Update - July 29, 2025 - Introducing the Fire Bottle Ability! 🔥
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

This week, we’re excited to add a brand-new ability to spice up your gameplay — the Fire Bottle! Now you can drop a fiery bottle that creates a burning patch on the ground, adding a whole new layer of strategy and chaos to your battles.

Update Highlights:

New Fire Bottle Ability: Throw a fire bottle to create a persistent fire patch that damages enemies over time.

We can’t wait to see how you use this new power! As always, keep the feedback coming so we can keep improving the game.

Happy gaming!
— The Dev Team

notes.title: Weekly Update - July 21, 2025
notes.content:
Hey everyone! This week’s patch brings important fixes, better visuals for explosions, and a major balance pass for one of our deadliest enemies. As always, thank you for your continued feedback and support!

[h2]🛠 Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where switching from a long-range weapon to a short-range weapon would still cause it to fire at out-of-range targets. Weapon range is now properly applied after switching.
[/list]

[h2]💥 Explosions & Visuals[/h2]

[list]
[*] Explosion-related objects have been enhanced: 
[list]
[*]  New explosion animations for improved clarity and visual impact.
[*]  Explosion sound effects have been [b]added[/b] (previously there were none), bringing explosive weapons to life.
[/list]
[*] The [b]Bomber[/b] ability has been refactored for smoother visuals and more consistent behavior.
[/list]

[h2]⚖ Enemy Balance[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Mutant3[/b] has been rebalanced:
[list]
  [*] This enemy, known for being a [b]deadly blood sprayer[/b], now behaves more fairly in high-level encounters.
  [*] Mutant3 unleashes a [b]wide-range red blood spray attack[/b], dealing heavy area damage.
  [*] It was previously overpowered after level 15; its stats and attack frequency have been adjusted to maintain challenge without becoming overwhelming.
[/list]
[/list]

That wraps up this week’s update! More tuning and new content are on the way—stay tuned, and don’t forget to share your feedback on the community hub.

— The Dev Team
